headline: Cross-modal corroboration CONFIRMED, MODERATE: SEDEF reference %identity correlates NEGATIVELY with read-PSV density (Spearman -0.443, p=9.1e-09, n=154); survives partial (-0.412) + n_copies==2 (-0.456) + join-permutation (p=0.0002). K-frontier no_psv families ARE higher-identity (med 0.9920 vs 0.9889) directionally but NOT significantly (p=0.11; SEDEF ceiling-saturated). CAVEAT: the strong axis is read-GATED/reference-SEEDED; the purest read-BASE axis (assign rate) is weak/NS (-0.138). Genuine cross-modal increment over the prior (different code+interval), but bounded; NOT a fully read-discovered corroboration.
